name: audit_list
description: Read the latest 50 audit outcome summaries, excluding details and source identity.

name: config_read
description: Read allowlisted routing and retry settings; no raw YAML or proxy credentials.

name: config_set
description: Change one allowlisted routing or retry setting after confirmation.

name: custom_icon_create
description: Save a named static custom icon from Base64. Does not assign it to a provider.

data.description: Static image Base64 or image data URL; capability input is limited to 32 KiB. Use the browser picker for larger artwork.

name: custom_icon_delete
description: Delete a custom icon and clear all provider assignments to it, restoring their default artwork.

name: custom_icon_update
description: Rename or replace a saved custom icon. Replacement updates every provider reference.

name: custom_icons_list
description: List saved custom icon metadata and reference counts, twenty per page; artwork bytes are not returned.

name: database_schema
description: List the OMC database tables and columns that database_query may read. Redacted columns and hidden tables (credentials, raw payloads, agent sessions, preferences) are not readable.

name: keys_delete
description: Delete one client key; all callers using it lose access.

name: keys_list
description: List client key identities and display masks, never secrets.

name: keys_set_alias
description: Change a display-only client key alias using its current version.

name: models_list
description: List models advertised by CPA /v1/models for an existing client key, with configured route provenance when known. Defaults to the first configured client key. Empty upstream_model or provider_id means unresolved provenance. Includes bundled models.dev reference metadata; it never establishes availability. No inference or credential disclosure.

name: oauth_credentials_list
description: List OAuth credential identities and status without tokens, emails, account metadata or raw errors.

name: oauth_delete
description: Permanently delete one OAuth credential. Its authorization will no longer be available.

name: oauth_excluded_models_list
description: Read provider OAuth/file-backed model exclusion defaults. A non-empty credential excluded_models list replaces, rather than extends, these defaults; a missing, empty or null list inherits the current provider rules. A rule is a model ID or a pattern where * matches any characters; provider * blocks all models only for inheriting credentials. This precedence requires CPA v8.0.33 or later; upgrade older gateways before relying on credential overrides. CPA determines availability; check its per-credential model list.

name: oauth_model_aliases_list
description: Read the global per-provider OAuth model alias mappings without credential material.

name: oauth_providers
description: List supported OAuth login provider identifiers.

name: oauth_refresh_credential
description: Renew one OAuth credential's tokens now instead of waiting for its scheduled refresh. Reports only whether it succeeded.

name: oauth_set_credential_fields
description: Edit allowlisted routing metadata of one OAuth credential: prefix, priority, weight, note, excluded_models (a non-empty list replaces provider exclusions, including *; a missing, empty or null list inherits the current provider rules, so clearing restores inheritance; this precedence requires CPA v8.0.33 or later, so upgrade older gateways before relying on overrides; CPA determines availability), expired, disable_cooling, websockets, using_api, request_retry (null inherits), request_scoped_errors (rules of status, match, match_regex and action; an empty list clears them), use_siwc (Codex only; uses an already bound SIWC partition; false preserves both partitions; neither binds nor verifies validity; since CPA v8.0.38 Alpha Search uses the ordinary partition regardless of this switch; since v8.0.40 Codex-client requests do too), model_aliases (entries of name, alias and optional fork, display_name, force_mapping and Vertex-only openapi; explicit openapi overrides credential defaults; omit or null to inherit; an empty list clears them); for a Vertex service account only: openapi (true or false forces or disables the OpenAPI route for partner and open models; null follows CPA's model-name detection), openapi_location (a Vertex location such as global for that route; null uses the credential's location) and openapi_models (model IDs to register from the credential; null clears them; provider-wide aliases can supply the same names). Credential secrets, headers and proxy URLs are not accepted here.

name: oauth_set_excluded_models
description: Replace one provider's OAuth/file-backed model exclusion defaults after confirmation. A non-empty credential excluded_models list replaces, rather than extends, these defaults; a missing, empty or null list inherits the current provider rules. Provider * blocks all models only for inheriting credentials. Empty models delete only the provider defaults, leaving non-empty credential overrides unchanged. Clearing a credential list restores inheritance, not unrestricted access. This precedence requires CPA v8.0.33 or later; upgrade older gateways before relying on credential overrides. CPA determines availability; check its per-credential model list.

name: oauth_set_model_aliases
description: Replace one provider's OAuth model alias mapping after confirmation. Vertex-only optional openapi is a boolean override; omit or null to inherit credential defaults and then CPA model-name detection. Aliases of the same model may differ. Empty aliases delete the mapping.

name: oauth_set_status
description: Enable or disable one OAuth credential after confirming its identity.

name: plugins_list
description: Read plugin status only; installation, execution and configuration are not exposed.

name: pricing_catalog_search
description: Search the stored OpenRouter price list by id or name, 20 per page, to find the upstream_id for a linked price or published rates and tiers to copy into a custom one.

query.description: Words from an OpenRouter id or name, such as deepseek chat; empty lists everything

service_tiers.description: Applies when the request was billed on one of these upstream service tiers, such as priority or fast; the response tier is used, and the requested tier when the response reports none

min_prompt_tokens.description: Applies when the full prompt (cached tokens included) has at least this many tokens

utc_start.description: Window start as HHMM (830 is 08:30) on the time_zone clock; set with utc_end

utc_end.description: Exclusive window end as HHMM on the time_zone clock; an end not after the start wraps past midnight

time_zone.description: IANA zone the window is read in, such as Asia/Shanghai; omit for UTC

prompt_price_per_1m.description: USD per 1M tokens inside the tier; omit to inherit the base rate

name: pricing_channel_delete
description: Remove one channel multiplier, returning that CPA provider to 1x for future requests. Historical snapshots never change.

name: pricing_channel_set
description: Set the multiplier applied to every future request one CPA provider (channel) answers, on top of the model price; 0.3 means the channel costs 30% of list price. Historical snapshots never change.

name: pricing_delete
description: Delete one current model price and its OpenRouter pin. A future sync may recreate an automatic price; historical snapshots remain unchanged.

name: pricing_get
description: Read everything needed to price one model: its current price (absent when unpriced), what auto mode would match, OpenRouter suggestions, a pending candidate, the channels that serve it, 30-day traffic and the 7-day median request size.

name: pricing_set
description: Decide how one model is priced for future requests: mode custom (operator rates in USD per 1M tokens and optional tiers), linked (follow one OpenRouter model id) or auto (automatic OpenRouter match). A time-of-day tier is read on its own time_zone, the vendor's billing clock, so off-peak hours published in Beijing time take Asia/Shanghai as written rather than a conversion to UTC. Verify with pricing_quote first. Historical snapshots never change.

name: pricing_sync
description: Request a price refresh from OpenRouter, the configured pricing source.

name: providers_delete
description: Delete exactly one provider and its credentials and mappings. Calls routed to it will lose that route.

name: providers_get
description: Read one API provider by id: display and upstream name, status, model mappings and revision, without credentials.

name: providers_list
description: List configured API providers and callable model mappings. IDs, not labels, identify targets.

name: providers_set_display_name
description: Change only the OMC display name, not the upstream routing name.

name: providers_set_status
description: Enable or disable exactly one API provider. Disabling interrupts its availability for callers.

name: providers_update
description: Edit routing name, endpoint, prefix, priority or model mappings of one provider, including Vertex-only openapi (inherit, enabled, disabled), openapi_location and per-model openapi overrides. Existing credentials are reused at the new endpoint.

name: quota_auto_refresh_get
description: Read the automatic quota refresh policy. interval_minutes re-reads credentials whose reading is that old (0 = off); refresh_on_reset re-reads a credential once a window it reported has reset.

name: quota_auto_refresh_set
description: Set the automatic quota refresh policy. Automatic reads call each provider with the credential itself; Meta credentials are never read automatically.

refresh_on_reset.description: Re-read a credential once a reported window resets

name: quota_clear_cooldown
description: Clear local cooldown evidence and CPA cooldown for one credential. This does not replenish provider entitlement.

name: quota_list
description: Read subscription plan labels and tiers, normalized quota windows, scoped capacity estimates and explicitly historical previous-cycle references. Missing or stale observations are not zero quota; estimates are not balances.

name: quota_redeem_credit
description: Consume an available Codex reset credit for one credential.

name: quota_refresh
description: Refresh one credential's quota observation, subscription tier and scoped capacity estimate, with historical basis when applicable; does not reset or spend quota credits. Meta observes quota through its key-exchange endpoint, which may mint a key; returned keys are discarded.

name: quota_warmup_credential_get
description: Read one credential's effective warmup policy, selected model, verified activation and safe paused reason.

name: quota_warmup_credential_set
description: Override a credential warmup policy or restore provider inheritance. Requires confirmation; does not modify provider credentials or billing settings.

name: quota_warmup_run
description: Send one tiny request to the exact credential to start an idle subscription window. Human confirmation authorizes quota consumption and possible Codex charges. Claude requires paid fallback to be disabled. Active windows are refused; never retry an uncertain result.

name: quota_warmup_settings_get
description: Read opt-in credential window warmup defaults, timezone and revision. Warmup consumes quota and Codex requests may incur charges; it never redeems reset entitlements.

name: quota_warmup_settings_set
description: Change one provider's default warmup policy for existing and future inheriting credentials. Requests consume quota and Codex may incur charges. Claude requires paid fallback to be disabled.

name: requests_cost_breakdown
description: Explain one recorded request's cost: its pricing status, the stored amount in USD nanos, the price and channel versions it locked, the tier that governed it, the service tier it was billed on and each token bucket's rate. Use it to answer why a request cost what it did or why it is unpriced.

name: requests_get
description: Read one request's safe accounting metadata; excludes raw logs and network identity.

name: requests_list
description: Page through individual request records matching the filters, newest first. For counts, totals or trends use usage_aggregate with the same filters.

to_ms.description: Exclusive epoch milliseconds; defaults to current time

models.description: Exact model names; for a pattern use regex

status.description: success or failed; omit for both

search.description: Literal substring of request id, provider, model, endpoint or user agent

regex_field.description: model, model_alias, response_model, provider, endpoint, ua or request_id

regex.description: RE2 pattern matched against regex_field, e.g. ^claude-.*-(opus|sonnet)

group_by.description: provider, model, call_point, client_key, credential, status, all

name: routing_apply
description: Apply a routing plan from routing_read: new priorities and weights for named members (key from the board) and changed routing settings. Moving a member to a priority above every other makes it serve first. Writes CPA configuration after a backup; credentials are updated one by one.

name: routing_read
description: Read CPA's routing board: every schedulable provider key and OAuth credential with its priority, weights and state, and the routing settings. Higher priority serves first; peers share by strategy, weight only under weighted-round-robin. The revision is what routing_apply quotes.

name: system_health
description: Check the OMC database connection without disclosing host configuration.

name: timezone_get
description: Read the OMC deployment timezone, optional override, and effective timezone. Stored timestamps remain absolute instants.

name: timezone_set
description: Set the deployment-wide OMC timezone for calendar days, console timestamps and service logs.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name; empty string restores the server deployment timezone

name: tps_calculation_get
description: Read the deployment-wide TPS calculation mode. include_ttft divides total output tokens by total latency. exclude_ttft subtracts first-token latency only when the output-token scope and timing match; otherwise the rate is unavailable.

name: tps_calculation_set
description: Set the deployment-wide TPS display calculation for request records and Playground. This does not alter recorded timings or usage.

mode.description: TPS calculation mode: exclude_ttft or include_ttft

name: usage_aggregate
description: The first stop for usage questions: requests, tokens, cost and failures over a window (default last 24 hours), grouped by group_by; is_trend groups by time bucket instead (data.groups is then a time series). Covers retained request records only.
